title: Establishing CFD Model Credibility for Hemolysis and Shear Exposure in a Centrifugal Blood Pump: ASME V&V 40–Aligned Assessment Across Three Models and Three Mechanisms
device: Centrifugal blood pump intended for extracorporeal circulation

models.name: Model A: Steady RANS–MRF (SST)
models.what_it_computes: Time-averaged flow using a multiple reference frame formulation with k–ω SST turbulence, Newtonian analog for whole blood, Eulerian shear-rate fields, and power-law hemolysis index computed from local scalar exposure.

models.name: Model B: Transient LES–Sliding Mesh
models.what_it_computes: Time-resolved flow with large-eddy simulation and sliding interfaces; non-Newtonian Carreau–Yasuda rheology; Lagrangian particle tracks of RBC surrogates to accumulate peak shear and exposure time along trajectories.

models.name: Model C: Hybrid RANS–Scale-Resolving (DES) with Scalar Damage Transport
models.what_it_computes: Detached-eddy simulation in key separation and leakage regions coupled to a transported hemolysis-damage scalar; computes spatial maps of shear exposure dose and near-wall shear metrics in narrow clearances.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism 1: Bulk hemolysis from sustained shear exposure
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Volume-averaged shear histories drive plasma-free hemoglobin generation and inform acceptable operating envelopes.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism 2: Tip-leakage jet shear spikes
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Localized high-shear events near the impeller tip can cause acute RBC damage disproportionate to their small volume fraction.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism 3: Recirculation-driven residence time in volute and backclearance
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Extended residence under moderate shear promotes sublethal damage accumulation relevant to long-duration support.

deviation.detail: All credibility factor ratings are reported on a 0–7 CredScale (0=no usable evidence; 7=exhaustive, decision-ready evidence) for each model×mechanism pair.
